facts.fact: StackAdapt announced a partnership with TapClicks, an analytics platform, so that StackAdapt customers can combine StackAdapt performance data with other user acquisition channels.
facts.quote: This integration will help our customers combine StackAdapt’s proprietary performance data with other user acquisition channels.

facts.fact: According to StackAdapt, marketers can aggregate native advertising-specific metrics, including time-on-site and content engagement rate, into TapClicks for all of their StackAdapt campaigns.
facts.quote: marketers can aggregate Native advertising-specific metrics, including time-on-site and content engagement rate into TapClicks for all of their StackAdapt campaigns.

facts.fact: The StackAdapt–TapClicks integration includes post-click metrics that StackAdapt says are now readily accessible to StackAdapt users.
facts.quote: Post-click metrics which are now readily accessible to StackAdapt users.

facts.fact: StackAdapt says the integration lets users combine StackAdapt analytics with other channel data such as social and search within TapClicks.
facts.quote: Ability to seamlessly combine StackAdapt analytics with other channel data like social and search.

facts.fact: According to StackAdapt, reports in TapClicks stay up to date with the latest StackAdapt data through the connection.
facts.quote: Connections, like those with StackAdapt, mean that reports in TapClicks always stay up to date with the latest data

facts.fact: Existing TapClicks clients must contact their TapClicks representative to have StackAdapt enabled for their team.
facts.quote: If you are an existing TapClicks client, reach out to your TapClicks representative to have StackAdapt enabled for your team.
